Realistic people (people/*.glb and their textures) are adapted from the Microsoft Rocketbox Avatar Library - MIT License
Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. https://github.com/microsoft/Microsoft-Rocketbox
Textures were resized and some were recolored (outfits, skin tone, beards); meshes were converted to glTF.

The walk, run, idle and dance motion in people/anims.json was extracted from Mixamo (Adobe) clips distributed with the three.js examples.
